data.description:
## Story

As a release engineer after the audit (S3), I can run a single migration script that reads the audit output and applies the `## Closure Checks` schema to all identified tickets — splitting transitional work out of `## Success Criteria` into the new section, with idempotency and resume semantics for large ticket sets.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-closure-checks.sh` created, executable; reads audit output from `audit-closure-checks-migration.sh` (or accepts a ticket ID list) and applies migration per-ticket using the v1.2.0 sentinel
- DD2: Synthetic test suite verifies migration correctness: (a) tickets with mixed SC/transitional content are split correctly, (b) already-migrated tickets are idempotently skipped (sentinel check), (c) tickets with no transitional content get an empty `## Closure Checks` section appended
- DD3: SC6 + SC7: migration script produces correct output on a representative sample of 5+ existing epics and stories (verified by running audit script after migration — 0 tickets remaining)
- DD4: SC9: after migration completes, completion-verifier (S2) passes against all migrated tickets in a synthetic test run

← Satisfies: "SC6: migrate-closure-checks.sh script created"
← Satisfies: "SC7: synthetic tests for migration correctness pass"
← Satisfies: "SC9: post-migration completion-verifier passes against all migrated tickets"

## Considerations

- **Resume semantics**: For large ticket collections, `migrate-closure-checks.sh` MUST support `--resume` via a per-session migration marker (e.g., `/tmp/closure-migration-progress-<session>.json`). The ticket system has 16K+ records; a naive loop will hit SIGURG or tool timeout. Document restart procedure in script `--help` output.
- **Batch cap**: Process in batches of ≤25 tickets, emit a progress line after each batch. This aligns with the existing 25-item advisory batch threshold in dso-config.conf.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: As a release engineer, migrate-closure-checks.sh migrates all existing epics and stories to use the ## Closure Checks section
